facts: arXiv 2609.38983 'Approval Laundering' defines 6 classes (Scope, Argument, Temporal, Tool, Delegation, Semantic). Its Approval Token prototype binds principal, agent ID, session ID, tool, arguments, scope and expiry; tested at Claude Code's PreToolUse mediation point (N=19-20 per class, 118 paired runs); removed Delegation laundering, reduced Temporal (p<1e-5); no significant effect on Argument (p=1) or Scope. Binding at the tool-invocation boundary cannot catch violations one process level below.
RMD-APPROVALSTATE-001 (provider-fix, last_verified 2026-09-07) only covers approval state staying in sync across lifecycle events; it says nothing about binding an approval to the exact execution.

arXiv 2610.00622: taxonomy incorrect import path, missing import, hallucinated library, deprecated API, unused import; 84% of generated files had at least one; docs-grounding + import/execution validation pipeline cut errors 38.1-54.6% across 5 LLMs/300 tasks, correctness up to +16%.
RMD-C12-001 (registry check + typecheck/build/test gate) and RMD-C06-001 (version-pinned docs) are the same two mechanisms the 2610.00622 pipeline combines.

arXiv 2609.38269 (Zero2Repo): failing submissions passed 90-99% of hidden tests; failures from single omissions and low-frequency spec rules; no mitigation proposed. RMD-C01-001/RMD-C02-001 (context narrowing) only partly fit; RMD-C03-001 (durable requirement list) and RMD-A07-001 (requirement-to-test traceability) fit better.

OpenAI changelog: GPT-5.3-Codex-Spark deprecated 2026-09-14; GPT-5.5 retires from ChatGPT/ChatGPT Work/Codex 2026-10-14 (API unaffected); users must update workspace defaults, saved model settings, managed configurations, custom agents, scheduled tasks and scripts; post-deadline behavior undocumented; no model-usage audit feature documented.

Anthropic Model deprecations page: requests to retired models fail; >=60 days notice; Console Usage Export CSV by API key and model as audit; example claude-sonnet-4-5-20250929 deprecated 2026-09-30, retires 2026-11-30.

No existing remedy covers deadline-driven inventory/migration of pinned model identifiers (checked RMD-D01-001, RMD-D14-001, RMD-D12-001, RMD-BETAGA-001, RMD-MODELSCOPEDAPI-001; grep of 164 remedies for retire/deprecat/廃止).

arXiv 2609.37216 (CRJudgeBench): 1,199 instances from real PRs; general SOTA LLMs struggle to identify plausible-but-invalid review comments; evidence-gathering Sentinel (Qwen3-Coder-30B) reached 76.60%, +19.78pt over base.
RMD-F11-001 already requires a verify (disprove) step; the refinement is the disprove step must gather repository evidence, not judge plausibility with a second general LLM.
inferences: P-20260907-CD83ACE2: lifecycle-sync provider fixes still hold; approval-execution binding is a separate consumer-implementable mechanism; drafted new RMD-APPROVALBIND-001 (candidate) plus an update to RMD-APPROVALSTATE-001 so the provider-fix record does not over-claim coverage.

Third-party blogs naming replacement models were not confirmed against OpenAI primary sources and are left out.

evidence.summary: Approval Token（principal・agent ID・session ID・tool・引数・scope・expiryを鍵付きcapabilityで束縛し、鍵はAgentに返さない）をClaude Code PreToolUseに実装し、6類型を各N=19-20、計118対で計測した。Delegation launderingは解消し、Temporalも有意に低減した(p<1e-5)。Argument(p=1)とScopeには効果がなかった。dispatch fieldが変わらない違反はtool境界の束縛では検出できない、と著者が限界を明記している。

Library関連エラーを5類型(import path誤り・import欠落・幻覚library・非推奨API・未使用import)に分類し、生成fileの84%が1件以上を含んだ。task分析→公式docs grounding→生成→import/実行の自動検証からなるAgent型手法で、5 model・300 task(LangChain/AutoGen)のエラーを38.1-54.6%削減し、正答率を最大16%改善した。RMD-C12-001(実行検証gate)とRMD-C06-001(version一致docs参照)の組合せを独立に支持する。

Zero2Repoの失敗はhidden testの90-99%を通過しつつ、単一の省略または低頻度の仕様ruleに起因した。論文は緩和策を提示していない。既存のContext絞込remedy(RMD-C01/C02-001)は部分的にしか効かない。仕様ruleを耐久的な要件list(RMD-C03-001)と要件→test traceability(RMD-A07-001)へ落とす既存remedyの方が適合するため、C02.remedy_refsへの追加を推奨する。
SPECAは仕様中のMUST/SHOULD等の規範文を抽出し、ID付きchecklistに変換して監査する。仕様ruleの網羅的列挙という方向性の傍証だが、Zero2Repo型の省略を減らす効果の計測はない。

GPT-5.3-Codex-Sparkは2026-09-14に廃止され、desktop app・Codex CLI・IDE拡張で利用不可になった。GPT-5.5は2026-10-14にChatGPT/ChatGPT Work/Codexから退役する(APIは対象外)。workspace既定値・保存済みmodel設定・managed config・custom agent・scheduled task・scriptの更新を要求している。期限後の挙動(fallbackかerrorか)と使用状況監査機能は記載がない。
Anthropicは退役modelへのrequestが失敗すると明記し、60日以上前に通知する。退役日より十分前の代替model試験を推奨し、Console Usage ExportでAPI key×model別の使用状況CSVを取得する監査手順を示す(例: claude-sonnet-4-5-20250929は2026-11-30退役)。

CRJudgeBench(実PR由来1,199件、test 359件)では、汎用SOTA LLMはもっともらしいが無効なreview commentの識別に苦戦した。repository証拠を能動的に収集してから判定するSentinel(Qwen3-Coder-30B)は76.60%で、base比+19.78ptだった。反証stepは別LLMのもっともらしさ判定ではなく、code証拠の収集・実行に接地させる必要がある。
